title: GRAPHICS OPTIONS
why: His pick from the feature list. Settings gains three rows: Render resolution (Full, High, Medium, Low; lower is softer but faster, and it applies at once), Frame cap (Off, 60, 30) and Effects (Full, Reduced; about a third of the sparks). The defaults are the game as it was.
now: GRAPHICS OPTIONS, his pick from the feature list: Settings rows for Render resolution (Full, High, Medium, Low, applied at once), Frame cap (Off, 60, 30) and Effects (Full or Reduced, about a third of the sparks). The defaults keep the game as it was.

edits.replacement: DPR=Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio||1,2)*gfxScaleNow(); RES_APPLIED=CFG.gfxScale;   // v16.xx: his pick 28, the render resolution
